# Only the shooter goes (b14: the host pawn stood in the line of fire); the look target is the live objective actor.

# b17 (senior, item 1): the objective's own action. The client, at the live stand point, fires the Morita at each of the
# three warrior targets until its death row; no tac support call here.
# Item 3 (b17, senior a): the Morita key comes from the client's card 050 row (slot 0 key One, slot 1 key Two; b16:
# "switch to weapon 1" on Two). Pressed only when the Morita is not the equipped slot: a press on the equipped slot
# is the underslung toggle (b14 279258619), and the targets must be shot with the plain Morita.
